the_ages.philosophy: Each technology is an AGE — like Bronze, Iron, Steel in Kenshi's own world. Each age builds ON the previous. Each age's tools become the foundation for the next. The Rusted Junk of today becomes the Meitou of tomorrow.

the_pitch.message: You spent 12 years building Kenshi alone. We built an engine that can carry it forward. AGPL — yours to use. The community helped forge it. We're offering it as the Kenshi 2 engine before Unreal ships.
the_pitch.leverage: By this point: established mod community, proven multiplayer, distributed compute, active player base on our engine

lore_parallel.insight: Each age maps to a Kenshi faction's worldview. We START as Holy Nation (primitive, fearful of the unknown engine). We END as First Empire Skeletons (transcendent, having built and remembered everything).
lore_parallel.stone_holy_nation: Burns what it doesn't understand (vanilla modding fears breaking things)
lore_parallel.wood_shek: Warriors by tradition (Lua scripting — fighting with what's given)
lore_parallel.copper_united_cities: Trade and exploitation (C++ hooks — exploiting the engine's exposed guts)
lore_parallel.iron_tech_hunters: Knowledge seekers (Rust layer — reverse engineering IS Tech Hunting)
lore_parallel.skeleton_first_empire: Transcendent (standalone engine — we ARE what came before, rebuilt)
